status: strong development candidate; NOT a shipped field

loao_refit_archive_held_out.ruler: baseline is the majority answer of the TRAINING archives; the held-out archive's own prevalence is unknown at deployment
loao_refit_archive_held_out.difference_from_ladder_loao: each archive is held out of TRAINING and the model refit; the ladder's loao() only partitions pooled OOF predictions and never refits

preprocessing.nan_semantics: zero detections means count 0 but ratio UNDEFINED; ratios stay NaN with explicit flags and are zero-imputed after scaling, never median-imputed (a fold-wise median would leak)

detector.justification: this detector trained only on external images -- zero local images, labels or folds -- so it cannot leak into any local validation fold and one checkpoint legitimately serves every fold

validation_discipline.how: validation cases receive only automatically detected regions; human boxes are supervision inside training folds only -- and for this arm the detector saw no local box at all
validation_discipline.locked_note: this run only; locked-47 has been consumed 7 times historically and had model selection done on it, so it is a CONSUMED internal holdout, not a clean final test set

output_semantics.permitted: ordinal correspondence with the report's low / medium / high malformation wording
output_semantics.forbidden: malformed-vessel percentage, or any per-mm / micron value
output_semantics.why: human boxes fall inside their own clinical band for 17 of 44 cases with roughly a 3x scale offset, so a percentage would assert a calibration that does not exist

external_data_licence.source: the dataset card's own YAML front matter, data/Capillary-Dataset/README.md
external_data_licence.obligations: Apache-2.0 requires the licence text and attribution be retained; cite Nguyen & Jeong, KDD 2025
external_data_licence.used_for: vessel-morphology detector initialisation only; the external diabetes labels were NOT used as patient labels for this project
external_data_licence.adoption_criterion_8: satisfied -- Apache-2.0 permits the target deployment

what_this_freeze_does_not_establish: external validity: all three archives are one site, so no result here is an external test
a shipped field: promotion requires a new, never-accessed test set of the same field definition with per-case independence
a calibrated percentage: the permitted output is ordinal only
